text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Cheval-chi~!
Take off your hoodie and let's swim!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-Wait up...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (The ocean... feels so nice...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Nobody's around...
I don't have to be embarrassed looking like th—huh?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Could this be?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you were already awake, Cheva-chi.
...What's up? Deep in thought?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I picked up a seashell earlier... It's really pretty, so
I was wondering if I could give it to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Seashells?! Wait, are you gonna do it too, Cheval?!
The 'Good Luck Charm for Winning Races'!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-What's that...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You haven't? Then let's do it, I'll teach you! ☆
It's super trendy right now because of how effective it is!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's super easy♪ Just write your name on one shell half
and the other person's name on the other~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We each hold onto the other's name♡
That way, our power of friendship grows stronger,
and we'll totally win our races♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!?
Wh-What's that, isn't that embarrassing... !?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No way, not true at all! I mean, your Trainer would definitely be happier if you won, Cheval-chi, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-Well... I guess that's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And besides!
Don't you want to win races too, Cheval-chi?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I mean...... I-I do want to win, but...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Then it's settled!! Right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I went and made it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(—No, no, what am I doing...!
Getting swept up by Vivlos, d-doing something like this...
Matching seashell charms...?!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"No! I'm sorry, Trainer,
but I... I really can't hand it over...!"
choice_data_list: What do you mean you can't hand it over?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaah!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! Well, actually it is, but...
I'm not really familiar with what's trendy...
But... they said it's super effective...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Still, after all... someone like me giving you this would probably just be a bother...!
choice_data_list: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inferring from their tone, they want to give something,
but are too hesitant to do so... I wonder if that's it.
choice_data_list: These were probably prepared for me, right?
These were probably prepared for me, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-Yes...
For Trainer... and for me...
choice_data_list: Then I'd be happy with anything!
Then I'll wait until you feel like giving it.
Then, shall we try thinking about it the other way around?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: Because it's not a bother at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She struggles to express her feelings, yet she prepared
this with me in mind. I need to look her straight in
the eye and tell her.
choice_data_list: Thank you, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...N-No way...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to... thank me.
Because... I still...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-T... Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Are you... sure...?
choice_data_list: If it's for you, I can wait as long as it takes.
If it's for you, I can wait as long as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah...
choice_data_list: You can give it to me whenever you truly want to.
You can do it whenever you truly feel like giving it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(――...Guh. What am I doing...?
You want to win, don't you, together with Trainer...?!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T... The spirit is there, I promise...!
So... yes..., just, a little more...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh... uuuugghhhh~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-T... Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: The opposite, you say...?
choice_data_list: Would a present from me be a bother?
Is a present from me a nuisance?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?!
N-No way, that's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I might feel happy, but...
I would never think of it as a nuisance, not for a moment—
choice_data_list: Same here.
Same here!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It's the same...?
N-No matter what kind of gift you receive...?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's... how it is...
Th-Then—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-T... Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: P-Please... take this...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the bag revealed a beautiful seashell.
Her name was carved into the inside of it.
...Come to think of it, I feel like I heard a story about that recently—
choice_data_list: Could it be, a 'sure-win race charm'?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!
Y-Yes... So you already knew...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um, i-if it's a bother, or if matching like this is embarrassing... you can totally return it...!
choice_data_list: That's not true at all—I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... T-Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if the charm will work, but...
just having you accept it makes me...
choice_data_list: With the power of our bond, we'll definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fufu..., yes...!
